city_fields.supportSceneAlt: A doula supporting an expectant mom in Cedar Park: Texas Hill Country birth support and doula care
city_fields.culture: Cedar Park sits in the Texas Hill Country just northwest of Austin, along the Balcones Escarpment. Known for its family-friendly neighborhoods, Brushy Creek trails, and the H-E-B Center arena, it has grown into one of the fastest-growing suburbs in Williamson County with a strong community of young families.
city_fields.medicaidNote: No — Texas does not yet have statewide Medicaid doula coverage as of 2026. Some managed-care pilots and health plans offer limited doula benefits, but most Cedar Park families pay out of pocket for doula support. Call your Medicaid managed-care plan and ask directly whether doula services are covered, or call Texas Medicaid at 1-877-543-7669 and visit YourTexasBenefits.com.
